title.en: Transferring the function of issuing licenses or permits for treasure-hunting from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources to the Office of the President
title.orig: Transferring the function of issuing licenses or permits for treasure-hunting from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources to the Office of the President

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00416_1990_html.txt

text.en:
All treasure-hunting licenses or permits, including those for treasure-hunting within the territorial
waters of the Philippines, shall forthwith be issued by the Office of the President.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 31st day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety.
